Name: Pet Facelift
Author: siamece
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MG1rt9U.png[/img]
﻿﻿This mod edits the dog and cat sprites to improve them and adds several new breed/colour options.
Part of my Facelift series that also includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8591]SVE Facelift[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are required. Hit download & unzip/extract the file into your Stardew mods folder!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rEOHdAk.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/27cELoJ.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/yNXbS8J.gif[/img]

Files:
- [b]Main:[/b] set the skin for your pet in the config. all cat 1s will be orange, all dog 2s will be ghost, etc.
- [b]Skins:[/b] adds skins as separate pets when making a new save/adopting from Marnie
- [b]AT: [/b]requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. use the scissors sold at Robin's to choose the skin for each pet. can be used alongside the Main or Skins version.

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                 [/u]
[size=4]
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/uUcgk6G.png[/img][/u][/size]

There are config guides included in the mod, but i'll include a text version as well just in case.
Cat 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 / Dog 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 correspond to what animal you chose when starting your save + if you adopt more later.

[b]Cats:[/b] orange/black/grey/brown solid, under, tabby, bicolor, bicolor tabby, siamese fawn/seal/flame, calico, calico dilute, torbie, torbie dilute, white, pitch black, american curl, scottish fold, chimera, halloween, lykoi, ghost, tortoiseshell, purple, pink, blue
[b]Dogs:[/b] lab yellow/black/chocolate, retriever cream/golden/red, german shepherd, german shepherd black, great dane, great dane black, husky, husky red, rottweiler, doberman, grey wolf, timber wolf, ghost, halloween, scooby doo

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                 [/u]
